entries.question: Which month does G go to the hospital?
entries.shared_directions: Six persons D, E, F, G, H, and I go for medical checkups in different months—January, April, June, August, September and December—and spend different amounts. I goes in a month with an odd number of days. I is two positions before the person spending ₹700. Exactly one person is between I and H. The number before H equals the number after the ₹1800 spender. F is three positions before the person immediately after D. Neither F nor D spends ₹1800. G goes in an even-day month. G spends three times H; I spends ₹300 more than G; H+E is ₹200 less than D; no amount exceeds ₹2500; F spends ₹500 less than D.

enumeration.method: Exhaustive enumeration of six month positions plus positive, distinct whole-rupee amounts bounded by the stated maximum, enforcing all amount equations, the explicit 700/1800 clues, and all position/month constraints. “Three persons before” interpreted as three positions earlier; this interpretation is consistent with the written ordering convention and yields the displayed table.

entries.reasoning: The constraints yield the unique order Jan F, Apr H, Jun D, Aug I, Sep G, Dec E. The amounts are respectively ₹1000, ₹600, ₹1500, ₹2100, ₹1800 and ₹700. Every numerical relation holds, including G=3H, I=G+300, H+E=D−200, F=D−500, I two positions before the ₹700 spender, and neither F nor D spending ₹1800. Therefore G goes in September.
entries.printed_key: B (September) marked on p.19; handwritten solution/table on pp.20–21 agrees.

retired_records.question_text:
Original Practice Question — Six different people F, D, C, E, A, B are scheduled in six distinct months: January, March, May, July, September, November. Each month is used once. Shared clues: F is scheduled earlier in the year than D. D is scheduled earlier in the year than C. C is scheduled earlier in the year than E. E is scheduled earlier in the year than A. A is scheduled earlier in the year than B.

Question: In which month is A scheduled?
retired_records.explanation: The five precedence clues force the complete order F → D → C → E → A → B. The listed months follow that order, so A is scheduled in September.
